description: This script handles platform-specific upgrade procedures for a device, including a check image function and a do upgrade function that delegates to a default upgrade method based on the device's board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A function that performs a check on the image, currently always returning success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: A function that determines the device board type and executes the corresponding upgrade method, defaulting to a generic upgrade if no specific case matches.
